newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Boram Bank sets US$1.5 bln MTN programme.
newsitem.headline: Boram Bank sets US$1.5 bln MTN programme.

text.p: Boram Bank has signed a US$1.5 billion global medium-term note (MTN) programme, arranger Merrill Lynch International said on Friday.
Under the programme, the bank may issue up to US$1.5 billion or its equivalent in other currencies in senior and subordinated notes, Merrill Lynch said.
Notes issued under the programme will be eligible for listing on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and for clearance through DTC, Euroclear, Cedel or any other recognised clearing system, it said.

The dealer group comprised Merrill Lynch International, Barclays De Zoete Wedd, Credit Suisse First Boston (Europe), Dresdner (South East Asia), LTCB Asia, J.P. Morgan Securities, Nomura International, Sanwa International Finance and Union Bank of Switzerland, it said.
Bankers Trust was listing agent as well as issuing and paying agent, Merrill Lynch International said.
Merrill Lynch Capital Markets Bank Ltd, Frankfurt main branch has been appointed as arranger for issues of mark-denominated notes, it said.
